text.p: The consequences of the grounding of the 68,676-dwt Panamax bulker Bright Field at New Orleans were being assessed in the freight market on Monday.

Restrictions have been placed on the movement of tonnage in the Mississippi with some loaded vessels understood to be denied permission to sail and other vessels prevented from moving up river to loading berths.
The question of force majeure may arise although no charterer has yet been reported to have declared it.

Brokers say that the effect on the North Atlantic freight market is hard to assess but there must be owners with unfixed tonnage in ballast to the US Gulf who will now consider diverting their vessels towards Argentina and Brazil.

Meanwhile the market opened with the usual Monday lack of direction, although some firmer rates were reported for Panamaxes in the North Atlantic and marginally softer rates in the Pacific, in both cases for early tonnage.
The BFI gained 6 points to 1507.
Grain brokers reported market expectations of imminent purchases by India, Pakistan, Turkey, Algeria and Morocco. Russia was also mentioned as a potential buyer.
BTC was said to have booked a Panamax on private terms for Russian interests for loading in the Plate to the Baltic.
Also private was Toepfer's reported fixture of Happyman 54,312 dwt from the Plate to Trincomalee.

Caper involvement in the grain trades continued through confirmation of Geepee's fixture of Theogennitor 116,978 dwt delivery US Gulf mid Jan trip Saudi Arabia at $10,200 daily plus $135,000 bonus, and rumours that Cargill had fixed New Luck in direct continuation for a transatlantic round.
Iranian interests may have booked Princess Clipper 118,049 dwt with grains from Nopac to Iran.
The fixture of the Belships-relet Anangel Venture 69,000 dwt to European Maritime Carriers delivery Bremen next weekend for 100/150 days was said to have failed.

Orders quoted today include Glencore with 55,000 barley northern France/China for Dec 20/30, Continental 54,000 heavy grain Nopac/Japan for Dec/Jan, NSAC 54,000 heavy grain US Gulf/Taiwan for Jan 5/20, and Soufflet 20/22,000 barley Rouen/China for Jan 5/10.
Rumoured handy-size fixtures include World Amphion 37,000 dwt US Gulf/Far East on private terms, and Andre 25,000 wheat Plate/Port Sudan at close to $39.00, possibly with Egasco Fortune.
MINERALS etc -- Ironore business was believe completed by Safore Australia/Continent and by Klaveness with Cattleya Star 158,570 dwt Nouadhibou/Dunkirk, both on private terms.

Coe and Clerici were said to have fixed a replacement for Sunny Clipper for 77,000 coal Maracaibo/Fos at a firm $11.00, and Cargill was believed to be on subjects for 55,000/10 Maracaibi/Ijmuiden for end Dec at about $10.50/11.00.

Carbotrade was reported to have taken the Goldbeam-relet Nemea 68,800 dwt delivery US Gulf Dec 21/28 for a trip to Japan with Petcokat $15,500 daily plus $340,000 bonus, although some reports put the figures at $15,750 daily plus $300,000 bonus.
Another Goldbeam-relet, Kostrena 69,346 dwt, was also rumoured fixed US Gulf/Far East, as well as Docelirio 75,594 dwt on this route, but details were not available.
There were unconfirmed reports that Darya Geeth 73,119 dwt was fixed delivery Far East Feb for 12 months at $10,750 daily to Japanese charterers.
Handy-sizes short period fixtures of craned tonnage were reported in the Far East.

Wadi Al Nakheel 45,000 dwt prompt South Korea was linked with Goldbeam for 3-5 months at a modest $7,300 daily, Archimedes 39,000 dwt also prompt Far East with Seatrek/Seanav for similar business at approximately the same level, and Maro l 40,000 dwt to HMM delivery Nopac/USWC for 3-5 months at $7,750 daily plus $135,000 bonus, but there was no confirmation available about any of these alleged fixtures.

Sincere Olympus 37,000 dwt was fixed on subjects delivery Nopac Tripar East at $7,300 daily plus unknown bonus, and Azteca 1 39,000 dwt by Unical for fertilizers from Kenai to the Far East on private terms.
Little business was reported in the Atlantic with conditions on the continent were said to be especially quiet.
